name: Kuan Yew Lee
role: Prime Minister of Singapore (1959-1990), Senior Minister (1990-2004), Minister Mentor (2004-2011)
summary: Led Singapore for three decades as a pragmatic, strongly state-guided but pro-business technocrat, combining export-led capitalism with public housing, compulsory savings and tight limits on welfare, opposition and press. He defended order, family and community duties over individual rights, rejected Western-style liberal democracy as universal, and kept religion and ethnic politics out of a multiracial secular state.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Built the Singapore Armed Forces and defended National Service when opponents asked to dissolve it.

abolish-income-tax.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

abolish-wage-labour.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

abortion-legal.rationale: Record: his government passed the Abortion Act 1974 (now the Termination of Pregnancy Act), under which a pregnancy may be terminated by a doctor on the woman's request up to 24 weeks, with conditions on citizenship and residence.

all-land-state-owned.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

allow-dual-citizenship.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

apologise-for-past-wrongs.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

arbitrator-settles-disputes.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Said integration, not assimilation, is the goal: go gently, and the logic of events produces integration; Singapore kept distinct cultures and languages.

automation-leaves-most-without-work.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Ran budget surpluses and criticised US deficit spending, but in the 1985-86 recession accepted a deficit and drawing on reserves to keep growth going.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Defended detaining communists and banning front groups who sought to overthrow the government by force.

ban-patents-on-life.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

ban-spanking.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

build-apartments-freely.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

central-planning.rationale: Said China's Soviet-style system under Stalin was the 'wrong system' and that the iron rice bowl produced low performance and poverty, while crediting incentives for growth.

change-traditions-that-no-longer-suit.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

character-from-environment.rationale: Said evil 'is not the result of being a victim of society' and that human nature does not change; also held intelligence mostly innate.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Citizenship for those born in Singapore required at least one citizen parent, rather than birth alone.

civil-disobedience-accept-penalty.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

civil-marriage.rationale: Record: the Women's Charter of 1961, passed under his government, legislated civil marriage (solemnisation, registration, dissolution).

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

class-collaboration.rationale: Said labour and management should cooperate as a team and that the 'them and us' attitude inherited from Britain must be expunged; amended union law to enshrine cooperation.

close-ties-china.rationale: Built ties with China but wanted a continuing US presence as the regional balance.

colonial-socialism-democratic-stage.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Said it is wrong for rich nations to exploit poorer nations, as it is for a man to exploit his fellow man.

conscription.rationale: Introduced National Service in 1967 and defended it as essential for survival.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Subjected himself to elections and described government as trustees for the people, while questioning universal suffrage.

constitution-recognises-indigenous-natio.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

constitutional-jury-trial.rationale: Record: jury trials were restricted to capital cases in 1959-60 and abolished altogether by the 1969 amendment, effective 1970, under his government.

country-wealth-only-from-land.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

criminalize-genocide-denial.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: As prime minister kept the law; in 2007 said gays were left alone, law left as it was for now and no gay parades, questioned criminalising what may be genetic, and expected the law to change in time.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Said cultures differ in their capacity for growth: those that do not value learning, hard work and thrift will progress slowly.

death-penalty.rationale: Reported as defending death for drug trafficking ('one death is too kind' for those who ruin families); Singapore applied mandatory death sentences under his premiership. Source is a secondhand report.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: In 1985 he said Singapore had 'studiously avoided the practices of the welfare state' and that subsidised living is hard to dismantle once people are used to it; in 1992 he said the US must cut spending, especially on welfare.

decide-locally.rationale: Said China has 'no alternative to strong central power' and ran a unitary city-state.

defeat-communism.rationale: Fought the Malayan Communist Party and warned that communist advances would envelop neighbours, though he later engaged China.

delink-world-market.rationale: Built Singapore on integration with the world economy and said that if not connected to the modern world 'we are dead'.

democracy-becomes-oligarchy.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

democracy-best.rationale: Said he was 'not intellectually convinced that one-man-one-vote is the best' system and that democracy is not universally valid.

democracy-needs-political-clash.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

destroy-worshipped-objects.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Record: Lee first proposed an elected president in 1984, and the 1991 amendment made the presidency directly elected (first election 1993).

distribute-by-need.rationale: Described 'to each his need' as the ultimate ideal relevant only after poverty is overcome (1965), but later rejected equal pay and levelling in practice.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Said 'you cannot have too many distinct components and be one nation' and that ethnic, linguistic and religious pulls become divisive under one-man-one-vote.

divinely-chosen-superior-people.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Said climate change is a serious concern and Singapore should minimise carbon fuels, but doubted that being greenest would change the outcome.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Said the individual exists in the context of family and that expanding individual rights has come at the expense of an orderly society.

economic-freedom.rationale: Argued stability and economic development come before democratic freedoms and that political systems need not match Western models.

elective-rulers.rationale: Record: Lee proposed an elected president in 1984 and the 1991 amendment made the head of state directly elected.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Defended detention without trial under the Internal Security Act, saying liberties must be adjusted to circumstances and that communists cannot have 'ballot and bullet' together.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale is about other international bodies (such as the EU, WTO, IMF or WHO) or about support, funding or reform without enforcement powers, and the statement now asks whether the UN should have powers to enforce its decisions against member states.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Preferred a well-ordered society resting on tested norms; criticised 'unbecoming behavior' and individual self-expression.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Opposed race-based privileges: said no one should face discrimination by race for a flat, scholarship or job and promised entrenched, court-enforceable guarantees; led the Malaysian Malaysia campaign.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Drafted entrenched guarantees in 1965, while his government kept detention without trial under the Internal Security Act; mixed.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Insisted on equal rights before the law for all races and religions (1965), but rejected the assumption that all people are equal in ability.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Stated the principle 'from each his economic best, to each his economic worth' (1965), attacked egalitarian equal pay as the iron rice bowl (1984) and defended meritocracy (1996).

ethnic-nation.rationale: Rejected 'one race, one language, one religion': Singapore has many races and one nationality.

ethnicity-statistics.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

every-country-ready-for-democracy.rationale: Said that a country must first have economic development and then democracy may follow, and that democracy has not brought good government to most new developing countries.

evolved-behavioural-sex-differences.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

exclude-trans-women-women-only-spaces.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Called nuclear 'the real alternative that can produce the electricity generation to match oil and gas' and explored siting options.

experts-over-public.rationale: Doubted one-man-one-vote and argued policy should be led by selected able men; wanted ministers recruited by ability.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Stressed the rule of law and the fact that no one is executed 'at the whim and fancy of somebody else' as an achievement.

femininity-compatible-with-feminism.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

filial-duty.rationale: Listed filial piety and loyalty in the extended family as pillars of East Asian success.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Record: the Residential Property Act 1976 prohibits foreign persons from buying restricted residential property without approval, though flats and some condominiums are open to them.

foreign-policy-non-interference.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

former-empire-equal-treatment.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

four-day-week.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

free-basic-services-for-all.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

free-trade.rationale: Backed free-trade agreements (urged the US to move on one, welcomed ASEAN-China FTA as locking Singapore into China's market) and in 1966 asked rich countries to lower tariffs on poor countries' goods.

free-trade-promotes-peace.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

freedom-is-self-government-of-desire.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

generational-constitutional-review.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

government-encourage-intercultural-conta.rationale: His government's 1989 Ethnic Integration Policy sets ethnic quotas in each public-housing block so that residents of different ethnicities live together and interact regularly.

government-nudges.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

gradual-change.rationale: Advised 'make haste slowly' on ethnic questions, said gays be handled slowly, and shied from social experiments ('Huxleyan') that depart from tested norms.

harassment-claims-court-access.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

harm-principle.rationale: Said the expansion of the individual's right 'to behave or misbehave as he pleases' came at the expense of orderly society; the state may enforce norms of conduct.

head-of-state-dissolves-parliament.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Said groups that evolved separately differ, 'most particularly in neurological development' and cultural values, and that genetics and history interact; said intelligence is about 80 per cent nature.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

human-decline-since-golden-age.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

humans-entitled-to-use-animals.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

immigration-favours-shared-culture.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Called it immoral for property ownership to let some exploit others, and based pay on contribution ('to each his economic worth').

indigenous-internal-justice.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its own rationale does not support its value under the reworded statement: it cites state-run accounts, not privately managed ones.

initiating-nondefensive-force-unjustifie.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Argued democracy is not universally valid and that every country must evolve its own style of government; said Western systems should not be foisted on societies where they will not work.

islam-incompatible.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts; left for the web phase.

keep-public-institutions-small.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

labour-priority-over-capital.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Record: the secular state he led legislated the Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act (1990) to keep religion out of politics, and made no law rest on scripture beyond personal law.

legal-duty-to-work.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Defended compulsory urine tests and treatment, backed harsh drug laws (including caning) and held up the US drug problem as a failure of permissiveness.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: His government cracked down on prostitution and he wanted casino resorts kept 'prostitution-free'.

limit-campaign-donations.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

limit-growth.rationale: Made growth the overriding goal and said being the greenest city would not change global outcomes.

limit-guns.rationale: Record: the Arms Offences Act 1973 under his government imposes heavy punishment, including caning, for unlawful gun possession and death for using a gun to endanger others.

limit-population.rationale: Record points both ways: his government ran the Stop at Two family planning campaign from 1972 (Lee tied family size to development in 1968), then reversed to a pro-natal policy in 1987 and later pushed higher fertility.

local-veto-new-housing.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Citizenship law under him required residence of more than ten years for naturalisation.

mandatory-environmental-reporting.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Proposed compulsory caning on second conviction (1967); by 1993 caning was mandatory for 42 offences under his government.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Judged China's regime more stable than any alternative and said it had got far, while saying its Soviet-style system was wrong.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Mixed record: he used prices and wage incentives (market choice of language, market pricing of energy) and welcomed multinationals, yet the state steered investment and ran state enterprises; he described himself as a pragmatist rather than a market purist.

maximum-personal-income.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

member-state-blocks-federal-overreach.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

military-force-beyond-defence.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

military-force-for-human-rights.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

military-organisation-revolutionary-part.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

minority-language-support.rationale: Required every pupil to learn a mother tongue and said Singapore did not suppress ethnic languages or cultures.

money-backed-by-precious-metals.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

morality-needs-religion.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

more-religion-public.rationale: Held that religious organisations should stay out of the political-economic agenda and that tolerance rests on keeping religion out of politics.

multipolar-world.rationale: Wanted great powers to balance each other through the UN yet valued US pre-eminence as stabiliser.

municipal-businesses-mixed-economy.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

mutual-intelligibility-defines-language.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

national-self-determination.rationale: Said the South Vietnamese must have the right to decide their own destiny; backed Singapore's right to stand alone.

natural-rulers.rationale: Held that about 5 per cent in any society are specially endowed and that resources should go to this group to provide leadership.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Governed an activist state (housing, health savings, education, economic planning) and said government must set the framework for growth.

no-central-bank.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Said that if people are mobilised on socio-economic issues by religious loyalties the consequences are bad for all; in 1959 and 1963 warned against dragging religion into politics.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Kept British bases until 1971 and said US military presence in the Pacific is 'very necessary'.

no-transition-to-communism.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

occupational-licensing.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

one-party-rule.rationale: Led a dominant party but said parliamentary democracy needs an opposition able to take over; he opposed communist one-party states.

one-spouse-at-a-time.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

open-borders.rationale: Said Singapore's 214 square miles set a limit on what it can absorb and restricted unskilled entry.

opposition-only-legal-channels.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

parents-choose-intersex-surgery.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

parliamentary-road-socialism.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

party-controls-media.rationale: Said press freedom must be subordinated to the integrity of Singapore and the elected government's purpose; the media should reinforce national values, and foreign-funded newspapers were closed.

pay-for-effort.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

pay-off-national-debt.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

physical-labour-duty.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

political-borders-follow-ecosystems.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

political-decisions-consensus.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: Told Singaporeans that detained communists were released once they publicly disavowed the use of violence, making renunciation of violence the condition of release.

power-shapes-accepted-knowledge.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Said East Asian societies want to modernise without being Westernised and preserve core values; at home refrained from suppressing ethnic cultures, while rejecting a revival of a 'mythical past'.

price-controls-fight-inflation.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

price-stability-first.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

prohibit-child-medical-transition.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: Called the American mission to convert the world to democracy a missionary urge, said standards of the late 20th century cannot be universal and that faster change cannot be forced without active intervention.

promote-ethnic-return-migration.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: His government introduced in 1984 tax reliefs for educated married women's first three children and school priority for graduate mothers with three or more children, though only for some families.

property-fundamental.rationale: Record: his government's Land Acquisition Act (1967) let public agencies take private land compulsorily so that land could be had readily and cheaply for housing and industry, treating private ownership as overridable for public projects.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

publish-international-agreements.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

race-social-construct.rationale: Treated racial groups as having real biological differences (skull shape, neurological development).

racial-community-economic-control.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

racial-franchise.rationale: Insisted Singapore belongs to all communities and campaigned for a 'Malaysian Malaysia' with equal rights.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Warned that ethnic, linguistic and religious voting causes economic decline and set out to make a common Singaporean loyalty.

racial-oppression-before-sexism.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Promoted an integrated multiracial society in which no community is set apart.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Record: Singapore under his government and since has had no statutory minimum wage; MOM says wages are best set by labour market supply and demand.

recognize-territorial-claims-from-conque.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Welcomed skilled talent but wanted unskilled foreign workers limited (1971: too many would lower standards); no single direction.

refuse-to-join-illegitimate-government.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale rests on general self-government, separate laws or no stated position, not on keeping a distinct economic system, and the statement now asks only whether a region joining a larger state should be free to keep its economic system.

regional-resource-ownership.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

rehabilitation.rationale: Believed in deterrent and corporal punishment (compulsory caning proposed 1967; caning widened) and said evil is not caused by victimhood and 'you have to stop' evil men.

religion-from-peoples-character.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Would tolerate a Muslim schoolgirl's headdress but required uniform for customs and immigration officers.

religious-nation.rationale: Rejected 'one religion' slogans; held multi-religious secular society is Singapore's model.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

remove-indigenous-peoples.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

replace-appointed-officials.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

reserved-seats-excluded-groups.rationale: Proposed in 1982 and brought in as law in 1988 the group constituencies in which each team of candidates must include a member of a minority community, to keep parliament multiracial.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Said he and colleagues had the responsibility to neutralise foreign-backed attempts to buy into or fund local newspapers to shape opinion.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Held that stability and order come first for developing countries and that political freedoms may be curtailed to secure development; said some liberties must be sacrificed for security and growth.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Record: his government passed the Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act in 1990, empowering the state to restrain acts that stir religious discord; this covers religious but not other hate speech.

restrict-private-adult-pornography-acces.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts; left for the web phase.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Said British-style unions with picket lines blocking power stations would bankrupt Singapore; his government kept strikes and union activity tightly constrained.

restrict-technology-exports-to-rivals.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: In 1966 supported commodity price agreements and lower rich-country tariffs for developing countries; later pushed open integration into the world economy.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Called himself a pragmatist: the test is whether a measure is necessary for survival and progress.

return-to-pre-conversion-religion.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: In 1966 backed technical assistance and loans without onerous conditions from rich to poor nations; later stressed self-help and culture.

rich-first.rationale: Said disparate growth rates across China are inevitable and endorsed its pragmatic path.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Introduced and promoted the scheme letting public-housing tenants buy their flats, using CPF savings; by 1996 about 90 per cent of Singaporeans owned their homes.

say-in-proportion-to-effect.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Developed Singapore through multinational investment, World Bank loans and CPF savings, not self-sufficiency.

separate-church-state.rationale: Said the government's outlook is secular, officials must be secular with constituents, and religious bodies should leave economic-political needs to political parties.

shared-state-rival-peoples.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

shut-down-tax-havens.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

single-official-language.rationale: Offered parents a free choice of English and mother tongue and said imposing either English or Chinese would have caused rebellion.

slavery-reparations.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

small-step-social-reform.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

socialism-needs-revolutionary-war.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

socialized-care.rationale: Said government should not provide what the family best provides and criticised substituting state support for the family.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Record: his government enacted the Arms Offences Act 1973, penalising unlawful possession and use of guns with caning and imprisonment (and death for use); the sources cited do not show licensed private ownership rules in full.

state-directs-investment.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts; left for the web phase.

state-finances-worker-businesses.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

state-harmful.rationale: Rejected anarchic individualism; held that freedom exists only within an ordered state.

state-laws-apply-online.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Stood for a tolerant multi-religious society with a secular state, not state promotion of atheism.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

strong-leader.rationale: Said there is 'no alternative to strong central power' for China and doubted one-man-one-vote; argued stable government needs decisive leadership, but did not endorse bypassing institutions.

students-direct-own-learning.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Sued and constrained opponents and justified detentions, yet said parliamentary democracy needs an opposition able to offer a workable alternative.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Built Singapore as an open export hub on foreign investment; import substitution appears only in his plan for a Malaysian common market, which he dropped after separation.

tax-holding-cash.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Warned against 'levelling down': in 1985 he said the less enterprising cannot be made equal by cutting down the enterprising, and in 1984 that people must keep a large part of the extra reward of extra effort.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: Said East Asians accept modernisation but not Westernisation, citing Japan as industrial yet essentially Japanese in human relations.

technology-design-reflects-political-int.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

term-limits.rationale: Record: he served as prime minister continuously for 31 years (1959-1990) and then stayed in cabinet; no term limits applied to him.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Said wars of the past taught East Asia the cost of conflict and that China cannot dominate the region.

torture-always-illegal.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

traditional-family.rationale: Called the family unit 'the building brick of society' and said government should not provide what the family best provides.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Said reviving a 'mythical past of greatness and culture' would be damning and that Singapore had no base of a common nation.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Accepted that Muslims decide Muslim law for themselves while non-Muslims are not covered by it.

unions-good.rationale: Built a cooperative, government-aligned union movement and called for unions to join productivity drives, but said British-style adversarial unions would bankrupt Singapore; mixed.

unions-run-economy.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Rejected free, fully state-provided care: in 1984 he questioned opposition calls for free medicine for the poorest hospital class and kept Medisave as individually owned accounts; in 1996 he described health care as individual responsibility with subsidies and co-payments to check abuse.

unpaid-domestic-work-exploitation.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

voluntary-union-payments-at-work.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

vote-at-sixteen.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

wages-fall-to-bare-minimum.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Told would-be arrivals without skills to look to their own territory's social welfare ministers: Singapore was not there to solve others' problems; hiring favoured citizens.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Drove the public-housing home-ownership scheme so most families own their flat; he said in 1996 this gave every family something tangible to defend.

women-organise-apart-from-men.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

work-centre-of-life.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

worker-farmer-alliance.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

workers-parties-campaign-reforms.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

youth-equal-civil-rights.rationale: No recorded position found in the local texts.

notes: Lee died in 2015, so answers use his own statements and his government's record. His emphasis moved from a 1960s democratic-socialist vocabulary (1965-66 speeches) to explicit defence of incentives, anti-welfare self-reliance and 'Asian values' from the 1980s-90s; later positions win where they differ. Several 2000s remarks (Islam, homosexuality) were softened or retracted later and are rated low. Primary sources are National Archives of Singapore transcripts; the 1994 Foreign Affairs interview (s1) was read from a full reproduction on tl.net, which the source title names.
